description: A minimal living room vignette featuring a low rectangular coffee table in warm medium walnut with tapered mid-century legs. On the tabletop sits a stack of two books, and atop them a rounded rustic terracotta-glazed ceramic vase holding a single arrangement of bare sculptural branches. The table surface also hosts a warm amber glow radiating from a table arrangement. To the left, the arm and seat corner of a low-profile cream boucle or linen sofa chair intrudes into the frame, with a small cushion tucked at its back corner. The floor is light blond oak hardwood laid in horizontal planks. A flat-weave natural rug is partially visible beneath the coffee table. The wall behind is smooth bare plaster in warm off-white. At the right edge, floor-to-ceiling black-framed sliding glass doors are partially open, with sheer ivory curtains hanging alongside, allowing bright diffuse daylight to wash the right side of the room in cool natural light. The overall palette is warm cream, natural wood, and stone tones — spare and uncluttered, with a Japanese-Scandinavian calm. Camera is at seated or low standing eye-level roughly 3 to 4 feet high, shooting with a normal lens at a slight three-quarter angle showing both the coffee table surface and the chair arm to its left.
